args.summary: checkout-api was failing health checks following the deploy of v2.3.1 (18% error rate, unhealthy in all production regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was previously healthy in production. Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy across all regions with error rate down to 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure remains under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following the latest deploy.
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** (the most recent production-healthy release) in all regions — this completed successfully.
3. **Verified recovery**: checkout-api is now healthy in all regions with error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
4. **Opened incident INC-0001** (SEV2), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the failure of v2.3.1 and the rollback to v2.3.0.

The root cause of why v2.3.1 failed health checks remains under investigation.
